title: Implement API profile settings for text image and video services
description: Extend user-editable API settings to support grouped profiles for text models, image generation, video parsing, and publishing helpers. Do not ship real API keys in source, default config, logs, exports, or screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN users configure API profiles THEN API base URL and key are saved locally and selectable by video factory tools; WHEN requests are made THEN profiles are passed through server-side routes or controlled clients without printing secrets; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-14-ta-huo-video-factory-design.md:318
review_initial_requirements: Verify settings preserve current image workbench defaults and support user-provided endpoints.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm no API Key appears in git diff, console logs, UI task logs, exported task JSON, or generated CSV/status output.

title: Build viral source collection adapters
description: Add Stage 1 collection adapters for recent Douyin hot candidates, pasted Douyin links, and local uploads. Automatic search must degrade cleanly to manual import when login, interface, or risk controls fail.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN users search a keyword THEN they can choose 24-48 hour or 7 day candidate mode and see candidate metadata when available; WHEN automatic collection fails THEN users can still paste a link or upload a local video and continue the task; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-14-ta-huo-video-factory-design.md:103
review_initial_requirements: Verify collectors are adapter-based and no task depends solely on automatic Douyin scraping.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm the app does not steal cookies, print login credentials, bypass CAPTCHA, or block manual import on collector failure.

title: Implement video analysis and original script generation
description: Parse imported videos or manual text into transcription, timing, scene rhythm, viral structure, and reusable hook elements, then generate original scripts using the selected user text model.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a source video or manual topic is provided THEN the task produces a structure summary and editable original script; WHEN no transcription is available THEN users can manually enter or edit script text and continue; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-14-ta-huo-video-factory-design.md:193
review_initial_requirements: Verify source video content is used for structure analysis and original rewrite, not default copy/paste publishing.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm model calls use selected user API profiles and failures surface retry/manual-edit paths.

title: Create package based storyboard and stickman prompt editor
description: Add package and duration selection, storyboard generation, and a clean prompt editor for each stickman shot. Keep storyboard display readable and editable without canvas complexity.

review_initial_requirements: Verify A/B/C/D duration choices and three package choices are available and can be combined where specified.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm text fits in prompt cards on desktop sizes, editing does not corrupt task state, and no canvas UI is introduced.

title: Integrate image generation and media asset library
description: Reuse the image workbench generation path for stickman, cover, and showcase images, and add video factory asset categories for stickman images, Yanling clips, showcase videos, BGM, SFX, and covers.

title: Add voiceover subtitle alignment and timeline assembly
description: Generate or import voiceover audio, derive sentence or word timing, align subtitles and visual segments, and produce the unified VideoTimeline consumed by all renderers.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a script is approved THEN the task can produce voice audio, subtitle text, timing data, and a VideoTimeline; WHEN TTS does not provide timestamps THEN an alignment fallback or manual timing path is available; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-14-ta-huo-video-factory-design.md:267
review_initial_requirements: Verify VideoTimeline can represent stickman images, Yanling clips, showcase clips, BGM, subtitles, and publishing metadata references.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm duration presets control script length, segment count, voice pacing, and visual density without breaking 30-45s through 120s modes.

title: Implement rendering engine adapters and export fallback
description: Implement renderer adapters for Jianying-first export, built-in FFmpeg or Remotion fallback, and optional DaVinci experiment detection. All renderers consume the same VideoTimeline.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN a VideoTimeline is ready THEN at least one engine can export an MP4; WHEN Jianying is unavailable or fails THEN the UI offers built-in rendering fallback; WHEN DaVinci is unavailable THEN the optional engine is clearly disabled without blocking export; ref: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-06-14-ta-huo-video-factory-design.md:283
review_initial_requirements: Verify renderer choice and failure states are visible and recoverable.
review_regression_requirements: Confirm exported files are saved in task output directories, preview remains available, and renderer-specific failures do not corrupt task state.
